selection_rationale: A layered gunline: one dreadnought as the armored anchor with massive coilgun broadside and heavy PD, two battlecruisers for fast flanking firepower, two destroyers for additional spinal-coiler damage and screening, and a frigate for cheap extra PD/coilgun fire. This mix concentrates spinal-mount firepower (5 ships carrying spinal coilers) behind strong frontal armor and 14 total PD turrets to shred incoming torpedo saturation, while the destroyers and frigate add low-cost mass to spread incoming fire.
formation_rationale: Destroyers form a forward screen on either flank to intercept torpedoes and dilute enemy spinal targeting while staying close enough (within ~100km) to overlap PD with the dreadnought. Colossus sits just behind the screen, bringing its heavy guns into early range while benefiting from destroyer PD cover. The two battlecruisers flank wide and slightly vertical off the dreadnought, both to widen the target geometry against spinal weapons and to add independent offensive/PD nodes without clumping. Ward, the fragile frigate, is held well back as a reserve/picket, out of the first exchange's focus.
